newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS - FX vols mostly flat, dollar/kiwi rising.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - FX vols mostly flat, dollar/kiwi rising.

text.p: Implied volatilities for dollar-pair options were flat in extremely quiet trade on Monday, with little activity seen in any of the major currencies, over-the-counter (OTC) dealers said.
"It's Monday morning and the room is silent. That's never a particularly good sign," said one OTC dealer with a major U.S. bank.
Just after noon CST/1800 GMT, implied volatility for one-month dollar/yen options was seen at 7.2/7.45 percent, unchanged from the U.S. open, he said.
